confirmedBoundaries: Only workflow_dispatch R01 on the owner repository/feature branch and attempt 1 is eligible; R02 and calibration are rejected.
An exact wrapper commit is required; the copied coordinator is retained and the checkout detaches to the frozen 77664fbe implementation without a rebuild.
Owner comment identity/body, discovery identity, raw ZIP SHA256 and complete restored closure are checked.
The original candidate remains byte-exact. Only three authority fields change in a separate execution copy.
Source, fixture, generated inputs, three bundle closures, both runtime closures, SDK files and host/image identity are validated before Windows input/appearance access.
API credentials are confined to the download step; checkout does not retain credentials and execution rejects inherited API-token variables.
The fixed four R01 cells are executed once by the unchanged launcher; original and discovery workflow jobs are excluded in bounded mode.
Per-process cleanup, empty job trees, appearance restoration and final held-input state are required for a safe collection disposition.
Partial output and failure records are retained. Product failure is distinct from unsafe collection; neither yields policy or integration approval.
limitationsAndFollowThrough: Offline controls do not demonstrate actual hosted image eligibility, Windows behaviour, process cleanup or product correctness. The real preflight and retained R01 evidence must establish them.
This disposition covers one authorised first-attempt R01 dispatch. The coordinator contains no retry loop; an operator must not issue a second fresh dispatch or rerun after failure.
If an evidence-only follow-up commit precedes dispatch, verify the reviewed coordinator/workflow/test Git blob identities remain unchanged and use the actual live HEAD as expected_wrapper_sha.
R02 is deliberately absent. A separate independent review of actual R01 evidence, including full-frame pixel review, audit and cleanup/environment evidence, must precede any R02 exposure.
A valid known product FAIL does not automatically prohibit R02. Unsafe cleanup, identity drift or invalid shared infrastructure does prohibit progression.
No integration, release, gate migration, threshold change, risk waiver, compositor guarantee or physical-display certification is established. PR76 remains NO-GO and PRs remain Draft.
The broader existing test suites are recorded in the implementation receipt; this reviewer reran only the 17 relevant coordinator controls in this final review.
Working-tree byte hashes may differ from committed blob hashes due to Git EOL conversion. Both identities are retained explicitly.
